sections.content: The plan defines R0 through R4 recovery controls, hash-bound prepared inputs, fail-closed validation, successor identity reuse, refresh-chain checks, legacy replay constraints, and read-only historical dogfooding. ADR-0057 is required before readiness.
sections.title: Recovery requirements

sections.content: The migration bridge only materializes the R0 RED test. It rejects unsupported invocations and conflicting existing test content, then emits the test path with an empty authorizes array.
sections.title: Materialization bridge

sections.content: Terminal validation checks plan authority, binding hashes, required receipts, ready skill-input evidence, test selectors, and non-authorizing outputs. The companion identity utility derives contract, registry, candidate, and closure hashes.
sections.title: Terminal validation
